description: Mock orchestrator demo data for direct-agent and multi-agent/group flows. Load this into the frontend workbench or pass as context to the mock orchestrator for reproducible demo runs.

agentRoster.description: Anthropic Claude – general-purpose coding agent. Default single-agent executor.

agentRoster.description: Local Claude Code CLI agent. Used when real CLI execution is configured.

directAgent.description: Single-agent (direct mode) flow: Claude Code receives a prompt, mock orchestrator streams text_delta events, and completes.

body.prompt: 帮我写一个前后端分离的架构的todolist系统。

payload.text: Working on: 帮我写一个前后端分离的架构的todolist系统。

contractChecks: GET /api/session/current returns SessionDto with runIds populated
POST /api/session/run returns RunSessionResponse with session + run
Socket agent:event fires text_delta per stream token
Run steps panel shows Session → Run → Stream → Diff → Artifacts
Inspector contract fields update from real SessionDto values

multiAgentGroup.description: Multi-agent group flow: orchestrator + frontend + backend + review agents are selected. Prompt includes @mentions. Backend dispatches one run per agentId; frontend renders event stream grouped by agent.

body.prompt: @Orchestrator @Frontend @Backend @Review 实现 AgentHub IM 风格的工作台，包含会话管理、实时事件流、artifacts 预览。

config.name: orchestrator
config.role: Group coordinator for Orchestrator, Frontend, Backend, Review

expectedMultiAgentBehavior: Frontend renders one message bubble per agent from merged AgentEvents
Raw Event Stream groups events by agentId with accent color coding
@Agent Menu shows all selected agents with selected state
Mention buttons insert @AgentName into prompt textarea

cancelFlow.description: Cancel a running agent run mid-stream.
contractChecks: Session.status transitions to failed or idle after cancel

downstreamProtocol.description: End-to-end downstream JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol flow through MockOrchestrator. Demonstrates the North protocol: initialize → session/new → session/prompt → session/event ↔ session/event ack → done.
